episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: On their way to catch a ride to Stow-on-Side, Ash and Goh take a wild trip aboard a mysterious and eerie ghost train.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Hoping to get his Pokémon Gengar to Gigantamax, Ash and Goh look for help from the Ghost-type gym leader, Allister.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After unusual magnetic waves affect his Magnemite, Francois, Ren works together with Ash, Goh, Chrysa and Professor Cerise to solve the mystery.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: When Lilligant draws the romantic interest of its beloved Heracross, Pinsir is devastated. Could a Pokémon flower arrangement class save the day?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Tired of their missions always coming up short, Team Rocket decides to follow Pelipper to find out who's in charge of the Prize Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The Space Center plans to use Ampharos' light to guide a satellite back home. But after Ampharos loses confidence, it's up to Sophocles to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Hoping to add to his collection, Goh brings Ash along with him to Slowpoke Island. After meeting different Slowpokes, they try the local cuisine.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Ash, Goh and Chloe visit a Pokémon Circus, where the closing performers run into a problem after the evolutions of their Eevees don't go as planned.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As the Pokémon World Coronation Series continues, Ash looks to challenge a rising star from the Galar region — but gets wrong directions from Team Yell.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While Goh goes to look for Pokémon in the Galar region, Ash ends up training with one of the world's greatest trainers, Leon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Traveling out to the Wild Area, Ash and Goh encounter a Thwackey with a problem: It only seems to have one stick when it needs two.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As he takes on his latest Project Mew trial mission, Goh and a few allies challenge the legendary Pokémon Articuno to a raid battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: To master a new attack, Sirfetch'd gets unexpected help from Dracovish. But will the move be enough for Ash to survive his upcoming battles?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: In a battle against Drasna, Ash realizes a strong bond between Pokémon is the most important skill of all.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: While on a visit to Lilycove City to meet a Sylveon, Chloe gets recognized by Lisia, who encourages her to compete in a Pokémon Contest.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: To drum up more support for Team Rocket, Jessie and James take over a radio broadcast and win over some unexpected fans.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: When the Pokémon in Cerise Park get out of sorts, it's up to a helpful Yamper to set things right again.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Hoping to help his Lucario grow stronger, Ash heads to the Kalos region to reconnect with Greninja, who teaches its protégé a thing or two.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Ash must survive an entrance battle with a popular trainer to earn a spot in the top eight. But in the arena, all eyes are on the underdog from Kanto.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: On his next trial mission for Project Mew, Goh must win a survival contest in Sea Mauville or he won't qualify as one of the chosen three Chasers.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: In a frozen land, Ash, Goh and Chloe search for a rare Pokémon while Lillie and her family hope to reunite with their missing father.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Back in the Alola region, Ash joins a Battle Royal with three other trainers. But when any team can attack any Pokémon, who will survive?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Goh competes in his final trial mission for Project Mew: capturing a Regieleki and Regidrago. Will he receive enough tokens to earn the title of Chaser?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: To prepare for the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash reunites with his many Pokémon partners to battle an old rival and get as strong as possible.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament is underway! Ash arrives at Wyndon Stadium just in time for a battle between Leon and Alain.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: At the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash, Goh and their new friend Hop watch as Lance goes head to head with Diantha on the stage of dreams.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends cheer on Cynthia and Iris in the third battle of the Masters Eight Tournament. With only one match left, will Ash's training pay off?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Ash battles Steven Stone in the Masters Eight Tournament. But can the Alola region champion prove he belongs on the same stage as the toughest trainers?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 29
Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: On a camping trip with her family, Chloe encounters friends from her father's past who help guide her in her decision whether or not to evolve Eevee.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 31
Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: In the semifinals, the Sinnoh region champion Cynthia battles the very first Alola region champion Ash for the chance to take on the undefeated Leon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: In the semifinals, the Sinnoh region champion Cynthia battles the very first Alola region champion Ash for the chance to take on the undefeated Leon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: As the epic battle continues, underdog Ash struggles to keep up with champion Cynthia's aggressive strategy — but he won't go down without a fight.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: The battle rages on, but Ash is down to his last Pokémon: Lucario. Can the power of their bond see them through to a victory over the Sinnoh champion?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 36
Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: On the eve of the finals, Ash and Goh enjoy a day off in town and run into a group of Nickit who've become popular for teaching other Pokémon to behave.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 38
Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: While Goh answers an emergency call from Project Mew, Ash heads into the finals of the Masters Eight Tournament, where Leon requests a full power battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: With each competitor down to their final five Pokémon, the battle wages. Ash fights to get an advantage over Leon, who effortlessly sets the pace.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: The fierce battle to determine who the strongest trainer is continues. Will Ash manage to see himself through to the ultimate victory?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: The mysterious appearance of a legendary Eternatus above Wyndon Stadium grants Ash and Leon a bonus round, where it comes down to partner versus partner.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: After picking up psychic energy signals, the Chasers set out to scale treacherous Table Mountain in search of Mew... but find surprises along the way.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: On Faraway Island, the Chasers make a startling discovery and find themselves transported to a mysterious realm, where Goh connects with an old friend.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Goh has a new ambition to become a trainer worthy of partnering with Mew — but he's not sure how to broach the topic while camping with Ash and Chloe.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: An epic battle with a legendary Pokémon reignites the fire in both Ash and Goh's hearts. But before they set out on new journeys, they must say goodbye.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: While walking through the woods, Ash takes a random path that leads him to exciting encounters with many different types of Pokémon — and enemies.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: Misty believes she's connected to a wild Clauncher by fate. Ash thinks his Corphish called dibs on it first. The only solution? A fishing battle!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: To cheer up a heartsick Brock, Ash and his friends take him to a nearby flower field, where he gets lost chasing after a tricky Psychic-type Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 50
episodes_data.description: On a snowy mountaintop, Ash and the team try to help a gloomy Beartic by encouraging it to regain control of its ice powers.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 51
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends decide to cheer on their old pal Squirtle at the Firefighting Squad Show, but the famous Pokémon's managers won't let the group say hi.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 52
episodes_data.description: When Team Rocket causes Pikachu to get separated from the rest of his group, Ash relies on their strong connection to track down his best friend.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 53
episodes_data.description: A friendly Lapras takes Ash to a remote island, where a fellow Water-type needs the trainer's help. But Ash can't rescue the trapped Pokémon alone.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 25 Ultimate Journeys Season 25 Episode 54
episodes_data.description: When a supernatural entity starts stealing heart-shaped objects from houses in a small town, Ash, Brock and Misty team up to solve the mystery.
